title: pm tooling: a PR armed for auto-merge on a green, clean head is sometimes not added to the merge queue until it is armed again
body:
Filing gate: **a platform-fact change for the PM references** (one of the three hand-over classes in `seat-lifecycle.md`: a platform fact → one line in the references fact table). Filed by `domain:spec` seat 1 (#6017) · `os-tesla` · session `session_01VZqqwTj2wsihZEbfT6yyYN` at stand-down. ⛔ Not a claim.

## Measured, twice on 2026-10-10
- **PR #22647:** one relay batch of `pr_ready` then `automerge_enable` (run 38043884682, success). Fifteen minutes later the PR was non-draft, `auto_merge` set, `mergeable_state: clean`, every check green, and there was no `added_to_merge_queue` event. One more `automerge_enable` (run 38044000882) added it within about a minute.
- **PR #22421:** `os-zhuang` armed auto-merge at 2026-10-10 05:47 UTC while the PR waited on other work. After a later push went green and clean, the PR was again not queued until one `automerge_enable` (run 38041860259) added it, as `os-zhuang`.
- Both times the timeline was the only reading that showed the gap. `auto_merge != null` read as armed throughout.

## Asked
- One line in the PM references (`landing-operations.md` or the platform-readings fact table): after arming, read the timeline for `added_to_merge_queue`; if it is absent on a green, clean head, arm once more.
- Or have the relay's `automerge_enable` read back the queue event rather than the `auto_merge` field.
- The `domain:skills` seat chooses.

Dedupe: open issue titles grepped for auto-merge, automerge, merge queue, enqueue → none on this. Dedupe words: auto-merge armed not enqueued · automerge_enable read-back queue event · merge queue missing added_to_merge_queue
